title: Age Curves: When Do Gujarat Titans’s Batters and Bowlers Typically Peak?
dek: When do batters peak in the IPL? Strike rate by age, relative to each season's average, shows where Gujarat Titans should expect their batters to be at their best.
excerpt: Among IPL batters with a known birth date, relative strike rate barely changes with age: every band sits within a few points of the season average. Age, on this evidence, is a weak scouting signal for tempo.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Relative strike rate by age band: under twenty-five {{ev:ac-u25}}, twenty-five to twenty-nine {{ev:ac-a25}}, thirty to thirty-four {{ev:ac-a30}}, thirty-five and over {{ev:ac-a35}} (season average = one hundred).
The bands differ by less than five points, so there is no meaningful peak; birth dates cover batters facing {{ev:ac-cover}} of balls since 2018.
Gujarat Titans' batters since 2024 have averaged {{ev:ac-mine}} years, weighted by balls faced (coverage {{ev:ac-mine-cover}}).

sections.heading: The Shape of a Career
body: Batters improve with experience and decline with age; the question for a scout is where the peak falls and how steep the decline is in a format built on power and speed.
CricField grouped IPL batting since 2018 by age, measuring strike rate relative to each season's average so that rising scoring does not distort the curve.

sections.heading: Where the Peak Falls
body: Relative strike rate was {{ev:ac-u25}} for batters under twenty-five, {{ev:ac-a25}} at twenty-five to twenty-nine, {{ev:ac-a30}} at thirty to thirty-four, and {{ev:ac-a35}} at thirty-five and over. The bands differ by less than five points: there is no meaningful peak.
Birth dates are known for batters who faced {{ev:ac-cover}} of balls since 2018, so the curve rests on part of the data.

sections.heading: Where GT Sit
body: Weighted by balls faced, Gujarat Titans' batters since 2024 have averaged {{ev:ac-mine}} years, on the batters whose birth date is known ({{ev:ac-mine-cover}} of their balls).

sections.heading: Survivors Skew the Curve
body: Only good older players keep getting picked, so the older bands contain survivors. The true decline for a typical player is likely steeper than the curve shows.
Bowling age curves need bowling-style and birth-date coverage that the data does not yet have.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Age Is a Weak Signal
body: Gujarat Titans should not pay a premium for youth or discount experience on tempo grounds alone; the curve is nearly flat.
Fuller birth-date data would sharpen the curve considerably.

methodology: Built from the CricField warehouse (Cricsheet ball-by-ball data, regulation innings). Generated by scripts/editorial/engine. Age = season year minus birth year (birth dates from CricField player-bio data). Relative strike rate = runs ÷ (balls × season-average runs per ball) × 100.
